title: Contrix Import Attestation Content Block
description: cx.content.import_attestation. Importer-signed re-encryption of source-Space content into mirror Space. Signature proves importer's claim ONLY; does NOT prove original author's plaintext. Reader UI MUST distinguish 'original author direct utterance' vs 'claimed by importer X to be from another Space'. See spec/v1/zh/extensions/agent-workspace-profile.md §8.2.

body.description: Plain-text fallback for clients that don't render import_attestation. Render with 'imported by X from another Space' prefix; do NOT show claimed_origin IDs to avoid existence enumeration.

import_signature.description: Importer's signature over canonical signing input = JCS(claimed_origin || content_hash || importer.actor_id || importer.imported_at). Proves importer's claim, NOT original author's plaintext.

source_export_policy_attestation.description: Optional source-side policy authority attestation. If absent or invalid, mirror reducer accepts event but marks audit status (export_attestation_{missing,invalid,verified}). Mirror reducer does NOT reject based on this field.

content.description: Re-encrypted source content as a standard Content Block (e.g., cx.content.text).
